title: The image of nil-ideal units is the pushforward of the relative unit kernel.
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J ≤ I quasi-coherent ideals [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and I ≤ the nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Write i_J: Z_J → X and j: Z_I → Z_J for the inclusions. For the unit restriction q [def-sc-gm-torsor] and direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the categorical image of ker(q_I) → Gm_X → (i_J)_*Gm_Z_J is isomorphic to (i_J)_* ker(q_j). No square-zero hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Refine etale X-objects by affine opens mapping into affine X-opens. On these, the structure rings of the J and I subschemes are B/J_B and B/I_B. A section of the relative unit kernel has a representative b with b-1 in I_B. The extended ideal I_B is nil since nilpotents form an ideal in a commutative ring. Thus b is a unit and lifts the given section in the kernel of q_I.

Direct image preserves kernels. Consequently the pushed-forward relative kernel embeds into (i_J)_*Gm_Z_J. Associativity of base change and the equality j followed by i_J equals i_I show that the composite from ker(q_I) factors through this kernel. The affine lifting in Step 1 is local surjectivity onto it.

A locally surjective factorization followed by a monomorphism is an image factorization in abelian sheaves: the categorical image is the sheafification of the sectionwise image. Its uniqueness yields the stated isomorphism; the coefficient lift commutes with these formulas.

theorem nonempty_nilIdealUnitImageRelativeKernelIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) (hIN : I ≤ X.nilradical) :
    Nonempty (image (kernel.ι (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf I.subschemeι) ≫
        gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf J.subschemeι) ≅
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} J.subschemeι).obj
        (kernel (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI))))
